summary: End-to-end testing of the launch feature: PDF export + white-label proposal email + customer acceptance page. 9/9 backend tests passed. Frontend tests 1-8 all passed (provider switching, save+encrypt, test-email graceful failure, send-to-client modal pre-fill, PDF download, send graceful failure, bad-token rejection). TEST 9/10 (customer accept page with valid token) revealed one real UI bug: the ACCEPT PROPOSAL section is gated by `grouped.length > 0`, so when the proposal scope is empty (as on JXQ8EYEQ) the homeowner cannot sign — only a 'being prepared' card renders. Backend API for /accept itself works correctly (verified directly via API in pytest).

ui_bugs.issue: ACCEPT PROPOSAL section (signature input + accept button) only renders when `grouped.length > 0`. When the builder portal has an empty scope_document (which is true for JXQ8EYEQ), the customer sees only 'This proposal is being prepared. Please check back shortly.' and has NO way to type a signature or click accept. Per the review request, the accept section must show even when scope is empty (signature input, email input, accept button must be present).
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Change `{!accepted && grouped.length > 0 && (` to `{!accepted && (` so the ACCEPT section is unconditionally rendered while not yet accepted.

action_items: Remove the `grouped.length > 0` guard from the ACCEPT PROPOSAL section render in CustomerProposalPage.js (line 195) so customers can still sign even when the scope is empty — or, alternatively, replace the 'being prepared' message logic so the accept block is appended regardless.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~20,556 lines — vastly exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (proposal_email, customer_proposal, snippets, builder_portal, etc.).

PUBLIC_APP_URL fallback in send_proposal_email is hardcoded to https://app.estdesignco.com — fine for production but the preview env (design-preview-131.preview.emergentagent.com) will email customers a broken link. Should derive from request.headers.get('origin') or a per-env env var.
_email_decrypt uses FERNET_KEY from .env — good. Confirmed smtp_password_enc never leaks in GET /company (verified by test_get_company_profile_hides_cipher and test_save_email_config).
Test-email and send-email correctly translate SMTP/Resend exceptions into 502 with `detail`, no stack traces leak to the client — confirmed in both pytest and live UI testing.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (Tests 1-8 pass; TEST 9/10 customer accept UI blocked by empty-scope guard, backend API path works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend white-label email + customer-accept flow is solid (9/9 pytest). The single open UI bug is CustomerProposalPage.js line 195: the ACCEPT section is gated by `grouped.length > 0`. After the main agent removes that guard, re-test by setting customer_accept_token='TESTTOKEN' on JXQ8EYEQ, visiting /customer-proposal/JXQ8EYEQ/TESTTOKEN, typing a name in [data-testid='customer-signature-input'], clicking [data-testid='customer-accept-btn'], and asserting [data-testid='customer-accepted-banner'] appears. Don't forget to clean up token + customer_accepted_* fields after.
rca of the issue: RCA — UI rendering condition for the ACCEPT block uses `!accepted && grouped.length > 0`. `grouped` is built from the portal's scope_document (HTML) + rooms; if the builder hasn't published any proposal scope yet, grouped is []. Net effect: the homeowner reaches the page, sees only the 'being prepared' card, and has no input affordance. Reproduction: any portal where scope_document is empty/whitespace will reproduce. Mitigation: drop the length check OR show an empty-state 'No itemized scope yet — your contractor will email an updated version' alongside the ACCEPT section so the customer can still sign by name.
